name: K4/10
title: Elecraft K4/10
summary: 10 W version of the K4 direct-sampling SDR: same RX, touch pan, Ethernet remote; KPA4 adds 100 W later.

f.band_scope: real-time panadapter + waterfall, per-RX hi-res mini-pan
f.roofing_filters: none (direct sampling); crystal filters only in K4HD KHDR4
special: 10 W QRP K4 (KPA4 100 W upgrade kit)
wideband main+sub RX (any bands, shared ADC)

extra.usb_note: USB-B = two virtual COM ports + USB audio
extra.lan_note: 100% Ethernet remote from 2nd K4 (K4/0) or PC/tablet incl. panadapter data
extra.io: 3× USB-A, USB-B, RS232, Ethernet, video out, LINE in/out, ACC, 12 V out
extra.upgrade_path: K4→K4D (KRX4/KDIV4 kit); K4/10→100 W (KPA4); K4HD (KHDR4 dual superhet) 'coming soon'; VHF/UHF ~15 W module planned
extra.ant_note: KAT4 option adds ATU + 3 antenna jacks; up to 5 RX antenna sources (medium on base jack count)
extra.dual_watch_note: main+sub share one ADC/BPF set (same as base K4); K4D upgrade kit adds 2nd ADC
extra.tx_current_note: page copies 100 W K4 spec (~18–23 A TX); 10 W unit draws far less — not stated
extra.variant: K4 without KPA4 100 W PA module, factory assembled

gotchas: Only 10 W — saves just $660 vs the 100 W ecr-k4; KPA4 upgrade kit later likely costs more than the difference
$5.5k for 10 W: ico-ic-705 / ysu-ftx-1field are the actual QRP portables; ico-ic-7300mk2 does 100 W for ~1/4 the price
No internal ATU — KAT4 is extra
Main+sub share one ADC — no diversity without K4D upgrade
Spec sheet on the page is copied from the 100 W K4 (TX current etc.) — 10 W draw not published
best_for: driving transverters / external amps at low drive
QRP-purist home station with flagship RX
not_for: anyone needing 100 W out of the box
